channel.title: UK Defence Journal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from UK Defence Journal (ukdefencejournal.org.uk)

item.title: Qinetiq completes flight with 3D printed titanium aircraft part
item.description: QinetiQ has completed what may be the world's first flight of an aircraft containing a 3D printed structural component produced from recycled titanium. The post Qinetiq completes flight with 3D printed titanium aircraft part first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: AtkinsRealis and Anduril UK partner on autonomous aircraft
item.description: AtkinsRealis has signed a teaming agreement with Anduril UK aimed at accelerating the development and deployment of autonomous aircraft for British defence programmes. The post AtkinsRealis and Anduril UK partner on autonomous aircraft first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK extends Light Mobility Vehicle engagement deadline to March
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has issued an updated preliminary market engagement notice for its Light Mobility Vehicle (LMV) project. The post UK extends Light Mobility Vehicle engagement deadline to March first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK awards contract for common one-way effector launcher
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has issued a contract award notice for the purchase of additional Threod CATA launchers to support the British Army's emerging one-way effector (OWE) capability under the ASGARD programme. The post UK awards contract for common one-way effector launcher first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: American stealth fighters arrive in UK in Iran build-up
item.description: Six US Air Force F-22 Raptor stealth fighters have been tracked arriving in the United Kingdom, with the jets inbound to RAF Lakenheath supported by aerial refuelling tankers. The post American stealth fighters arrive in UK in Iran build-up first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Largest U.S build up since Gulf War happening now near Iran
item.description: A surge in US military air activity across Europe and the Middle East is being described as the most significant movement of American aircraft in decades during a period of heightened tensions with Iran. The post Largest U.S build up since Gulf War happening now near Iran first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK awards contract for Nyan one-way effector
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has issued a contract award notice for the procurement of the Callen-Lenz Nyan One-Way Effector (OWE), saying it will strengthen deep fires capability for UK forces deployed on Operation Cabrit. The post UK awards contract for Nyan one-way effector first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK outlines steps to speed up Type 31 frigate build
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has outlined measures it says are helping to accelerate delivery of the Royal Navy’s Type 31 frigates. The post UK outlines steps to speed up Type 31 frigate build first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: MOD confirms Palantir contract was direct award
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has confirmed that its agreement with Palantir for defence data analytics was awarded through a direct award process, citing a lack of viable alternatives. The post MOD confirms Palantir contract was direct award first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK rules out buying light tank capability
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has confirmed that the British Army currently has no requirement for a light tank capability. The post UK rules out buying light tank capability first appeared on UK Defence Journal.
